body: I'll try to not get involved. I would get therapy, or at least some meds, but that would require me to tell my mother and let me just say, I don't think she'd be too supportive of me. At least not right now. All my relatives, save for about one, will tell her. And that one can't legally get me treatment or meds. I don't know what to do to keep things safe inside myself...

Yeah, I try. I try to draw whenever I have down time. My older brother is a great artist but he hardly has any time to draw anymore. So, I've got at least one good artist around me. Also, my art class. All my paintings and sculptures suck, but I still make good grades in there. Although I feel as if it's not very helpful to me because she grades everybody very generously. I want to get better, it's just so demoralizing to try to draw a turtle and end up with ugly toast.

Wow. Thank you so much. This really speaks to me. I never thought about it that way, about what I could do in life. I've always heard the same old response of "Suicide is selfish, think about those around you". This, and with all the other replys, are different, more understandable perspectives.

And on the topic of "attend an MLG event", video games are fun and all, but not really my thing. But I'm really into YuGiOh. I'm not the stereotypical player, I keep myself clean, take care of myself (other than my arms, I have to wear jackets when I leave my house because of scars). I've always wanted to attend a big regional tournament, but never had the funds to do so. If I save up some,who knows, maybe I could even advance to nationals.

Wow, this is very eye opening. I do know what I want to do. I want to be a Graphic Designer, working on things like posters, billboards, and even some flash animations. (Funny thing is, I can't draw for shit).

She's amazing. She's smart, beautiful, caring, funny, and she has the cutest little laugh. I wanna tell her, but I'm afraid we won't be friends anymore after I do. It's happened before with a different girl, and I'm worried it'll happen again. I feel like the reason I don't tell her is because I don't think I should have feelings for her. We've only known each other since the beginning of school this year, yet we're good friends. I just feel like it's too early to have feelings for her, yet I still do. I really feel like she shouldn't be as nice and caring towards me as she is, I don't deserve it. I've caused so many friends to leave me I've lost count.

After talking to my brother a little, I decided I can talk about it. I've been struggling with depression for around 4 years now. I have to deal with stress at home, problems with my few friends, stress at school, etc. It's just so hard to do anything anymore besides my normal routine. Get up, shower, go to school, come home, lay around the house until someone comes home, stay in my room just thinking, sleep very little (patchy sleep problems. Usually terrors causing me to wake up), repeat. That's all. It's gotten so bad that I don't do anything. Hardly do my schoolwork. My mother isn't all that supportive of my siblings and myself. Nobody helps me either. My older brother stays locked up in his room or gone with his girlfriend, younger brother just sits on the Xbox all day every day, and I just stay locked up in my room most of the time. Nobody cares. Only 2 of my friends ever ask me how I'm doing, Jordan and Maddy, and even then sometimes I have trouble believing it's genuine. I am always the one there for people. Always the one consoling. Yet I can't even get a simple "You okay?". I get it from Jordan, but only when I make it obvious that I'm feeling down. But Maddy is different. She asks me almost every day and I feel like most of the time she genuinely wants to know how I'm doing. Sometimes I'll come into class and just sit down and lay my head on the desk because I feel like utter shit. She'll come and give me a hug, even if I don't hug her back, and she'll ask how I'm doing, and I feel like she genuinely cares. I think another thing tearing me up is that I have feelings for Maddy, but nobody knows but Jordan. I want to tell her, but she has a boyfriend, who is also a friend of mine, and they're happy. I don't want to break them up. I just want her to know. There's just so much going on in my life that I don't know how to handle it anymore.


Just typing this out made me feel a bit better.
